name: eme-probe
actions: new Promise(async (resolve) => { const out={}; const config=[{initDataTypes:['cenc'], audioCapabilities:[{contentType:'audio/mp4; codecs="mp4a.40.2"'}], videoCapabilities:[{contentType:'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E"'}]}]; for (const ks of ['com.widevine.alpha','com.microsoft.playready','org.w3.clearkey']) { try { const a=await navigator.requestMediaKeySystemAccess(ks, config); out[ks]='supported:'+a.keySystem; } catch(e) { out[ks]='error:'+e.name+':'+(e.message||''); } } resolve(JSON.stringify(out)); })
